    About this browser edition
    Based on SOTAtoADIF by Jack G5JDA. Supports the original project's implemented activator workflow. Chaser logs and separate S2S merging are not supported. Existing S2S data in an activator CSV is retained with corrected SOTA_REF fields. Rows without a valid band, mode, date, or station locator are excluded and reported. Times are treated as UTC.
    For LoTW/TQSL usage, read the original guidance and check station locations before importing. Conversion is local; optional live enrichment requires internet access. You can disable it and enter summit locators manually.
